1 finite results: applyCovariance/applyPrecision/precisionQuadratic/precisionDiagonal validate outputs (NonFinite("covariance result"|"precision result"|"quadratic result"|"precision diagonal")); fit refuses non-finite second moments/means (NonFinite("residual second moments")); whitened loadings and QR R checked. Regressions: D=MaxValue,U=0 -> covariance [2] refused; D=MinPositive -> precision/quadratic of 1e300 refused; 6x4 residuals with a +/-1e200 column refused at moments.
2 stability: adopted your expert's augmented compact QR. A=[D^-1/2 U; I_h] ((p+h) x h, no pivoting, exactly h directions, never qr.q); precision = D^-1/2 * top p rows of Q(zero_h(Q^T [D^-1/2 x; 0])); quadratic = |tail_h(Q^T[y;0])|^2; logdet = sum log d + 2 sum log|R_kk|; typed FactorizationFailed if any R_kk is non-positive/non-finite. precisionDiagonal: fast 1-|(Q_1)_i|^2 only where >= 1e-6 (rounding <= ~h eps/1e-6 relative), else exact positive tail-square sum via applyQT in chunks of 64 rows (bounded (p+h) x 64), so no O(p^2 h) cost at whole-brain p and no p x p allocation; every entry strictly positive. Your focus regressions added: D1/U1e8 (precision, diagonal, quadratic, logdet vs analytic, rel 1e-12); D(1,4)/U(1e8,0) span+complement; p1 h2 U(1e8,1e8); rotated span/complement vs analytic; duplicate+zero columns vs dense oracle; multi-RHS; symmetric positive bilinear form. Limitation documented on applyPrecision and tested honestly: along a span with cond(Psi)~1e16 the applied vector is backward stable (abs error ~eps|x|/min d) but not relatively accurate (simulated numpy Householder gives O(1) relative there); quadratic forms and diagonal stay relatively accurate (1e-16 exact vs 9.99e-17).
3 memory: ResidualCovarianceWork now storedCells, peakCellsUpperBound, cumulativeCells — documented as a plan from this module's own allocation sites, not an observed peak; peak bound = fixed + every retained rank result + largest single-rank transient (fixes primary+sensitivity retention and the u/clone/EmResult copies; EmResult no longer keeps a loadings clone). Work helpers take columns and return Left(Shape("work columns",...)) for c < 1.
4 binding: fit refuses TrainingRowsMismatch(declared, actual) unless training.declaredSampleAxis.size == n; fixtures bind exactly n rows. Receipt doc states centering is necessary not sufficient and unexplained-variation provenance is the caller's declaration (recorded, not verified); I am not claiming full residual qualification from FA-EM checks.
Secondary: restrict requires ROI role, basis, units and scale equal to the fitted axis (IncompatibleRoi(field, expected, actual)) before key selection; tested units and basis.
Also: reported logLikelihood/BIC/sensitivity use the stable QR quadratic sum (chunked); EM trace kept for monotonicity. Please re-review.
